entities.name: Jund
entities.description: One of Alara's shards, a savage volcanic world where only the strong survive and life is lived moment to moment.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose fragments, or shards, include Jund.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A powerful hero of Jund, an accomplished warrior who probably knows a handful of spells thanks to his mentor Colfenor.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Rhys's mentor, who taught him spells.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker and fire mage used as an example of how a mage thinks about casting a spell such as Magma Spray.

entities.name: Goblins of Jund
entities.description: Furry goblins who live in the peaks of Jund and raid down into the valleys.

entities.name: Thrinax
entities.description: A predatory species of Jund that drools at the smell of fear.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Lizard-like inhabitants of Jund whose skulls warriors split with axes.

entities.name: Hellkite
entities.description: A dragon-like predator of Jund that strafes valleys and feeds on clans.

entities.name: Hellion
entities.description: A monster of Jund that can burst out of the ground beneath a traveler's feet.

entities.name: Finks
entities.description: Durable little ouphes that Jaya Ballard might choose to roast thoroughly.

events.summary: The column describes the single rule of Jund, that the strong survive, with no hierarchy, planar quest, riddles or prophecies.
Jund's warriors keep only what they can carry, and weave trophies of past kills into their hair.
events.quote: Many of Jund's human warriors weave trophies of past kills into their hair

events.summary: The column imagines a Jund inhabitant's sudden death: devoured by a plant, a hellion, goblin raiders, or a hellkite feeding on a clan.
events.quote: Maybe a hellkite decides it's tired of goblin meat, and strafes your valley from above, and then gorges itself on the charred remains of your clan.

relations.note: Rhys knows spells thanks to his mentor.
Jund is one of Alara's shards.
relations.quote: All of Alara's shards have a soft spot in my heart for various reasons, but Jund might just be my favorite.
